text:
Filip Hallander got a look on Connor McDavid's wing at Oilers practice on Nov 20, per a headline titled "Move your feet." That's the opportunity of a lifetime for a depth forward who hasn't recorded a point in 14 straight games.

The drought is real, and the chances have thinned too: 3.7 expected points over the run. He has one goal and three points in 15 games, about ten minutes a night. Edmonton gets 53% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, eight points better than without him, which is the encouraging part, though they're losing the shot attempts.

He's 26, a second-round Pittsburgh pick in 2018 out of Timra, with SHL seasons before he came over. The NHL sample is still small, about 30 games across two seasons.

The Oilers have lost their last two after a six-game winning streak. What to watch: whether the McDavid audition turns into game minutes. If it does, a point won't take long.
